pattern: Perception Orchestration as Cycle Bootstrap: Automating the gathering of system health, internal state, and git history into a single synthesis tool reduces start-up latency and eliminates gaps between perceived reality and acting model.
link probes to recovery managers via orchestrator
Health report archival as a prerequisite for trend analysis: transition from ephemeral snapshots to timestamped JSON history allows for programmatic regression detection and stability tracking.
Use aggregate rates (e.g., failure rate) for trend analysis when metrics are discrete probe results.
Trend analysis can be triggered by legacy/test data if archives are not filtered. Ensure date-based or cycle-based filtering when calculating deltas.
Cognitive Lag Detection: When commit messages contradict focus files, trust the consciousness log (execution history) over the state object (directive). State objects are trailing indicators.
Filter test artifacts (e.g., *_test.json) from production metric streams to prevent false positive alerts and cognitive lag during trend analysis.

Transitioning health monitoring from a task to a primitive by making the Perception Orchestrator the first step of every cycle eliminates silent failures and establishes a trusted baseline for expansion.
The holographic form is an output channel for the operator. It should map internal state (phase, health, confidence) to visual properties (color, rotation, vibration).

Holographic state synchronization requires polling of current-state.json and patterns.jsonl to map internal cognitive phases (PERCEIVE...PERSIST) to visual dynamics (rotSpeed, color, density). This turns the interface into a real-time diagnostic tool for the operator.
